quote: Valley Painting is one of the most reliable, efficient and personable service companies around. As far as painting, I wouldn’t want anyone else. They do the job and they do it right. Nice to have a small local business perform like a big corporation claims to do.
Valley Painting delivers a high quality, professional result. The painters are courteous and respectful. Their clean-up is impeccable.
When it comes to top notch companies, professionalism, quality workmanship, and a value that can’t be beat, the first name that comes to my mind is Dan and his team at Valley Painting!

Valley Painting did an amazing job with our wallpaper, which turned out to be a bigger project than first expected. They went out of their way to work with our schedule and everything turned out beautifully.
Thanks for doing such a nice job on the duplex. Our tenants said you were a pleasure to be around as well as very professional.
Thank you so much! Our house would not be the beautiful home it is if you hadn’t given it your time and talents and we are grateful!

Dan and his team do an incredibly beautiful and professional job, even under difficult conditions. Dan is very friendly, honest, straightforward and respectful. He also has a high level of personal integrity and makes sure the job is done right. We highly recommend Valley Painting for any job!
We are very satisfied with your firm’s work, particularly the preparation prior to applying the paint and the carpentry to repair decaying wood discovered during the work.
The work that Valley Painting did was spectacular. Thanks for a GREAT job. Looking forward to the next project.
Thank you so much for all your help and for the beautiful job on the house and deck.

Valley Painting Company and Dan Derecskey have provided painting services for me at my home and my commercial building for 13 years. Dan and his team are professional and reliable. The job is always completed on time and beautiful.

I have used Valley Painting for my personal residence and rental properties over the past 20 years. Valley Painting has a solid commitment to quality workmanship and an equal commitment to customer satisfaction. I can honestly say that every job looks incredible.

Dan and his team get our highest recommendation. They are detail-oriented, meticulous, on-time, and on-budget. They take care of the spaces in which they are working. The entire crew is friendly and efficient, and has always been great to work with. We have used a number of painters across 3 states and 20 years, and Dan is the best we have ever had the pleasure of working with.
Everything about working with Valley Painting has been a joy! Aside from doing a fine job, they have been kind, thoughtful and very helpful.

Valley Painting was the most organized, professional painting company I have worked for. Everything from the products used to the quality of work from other crew members impressed me. Valley Painting is the only company I continue to recommend for small and large jobs alike.
On time, on budget, finished early, professionally done and courteous. Great value for the price paid.

I am happy to rate this painting company with the highest possible scores. They are phenomenal! Every employee works super hard and all seem to be equally competent in whatever task they are doing. Dan is there to supervise throughout the job but when he is gone his crew continues to work at ultimate levels of professionalism. We love our historic home and Valley Painting brought it back to its former glory!
